title: Most news apps treat everyone like they have the exact same interests.
body:
We all have different jobs, different hobbies, and different reasons for wanting to stay informed. Yet, when you open a typical news aggregator, you see the same top stories as everyone else. It is a one-size-fits-all approach that ignores how we actually consume information.

Personalization shouldn't mean hiding the news you need to see. It should mean organizing the noise so you can find the signal faster. When technology is built to learn what you actually care about, you spend less time scrolling past irrelevant headlines and more time understanding the topics that impact your life.

We believe news should adapt to the reader, not the other way around. By using AI to filter out the clutter, we can make staying informed feel less like a chore and more like a tool for your day.
cta: You can see how we are rethinking the feed at HEADLINNE.com.
